senses.gloss: रन् personal ending रन् substituted for the personat ending झ of the प्रथमपुरुष (third person) Atmanepada of 'lin' (potential and benedictive); cf. झस्य रन् P.III. 4.105.

रनु [RENOU,LOUIS] a sound Sans- krit scholar of France of the present time who has written some trea- tises and many articles on Sanskrit grammar out of which his works on the Terminology of Sanskrit Grammar, Kasika and Durghata- vrtti reguire a special mention.
